Read files from Google Cloud Storage.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Downloads and reads files from Google Cloud Storage buckets.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Cloud Storage](../categories/cloud-storage.md) |
| Status | Can't run yet |
| Search words | google, gcs, cloud, storage, read |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Loaded data |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bucket | `bucket` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | GCS bucket name. |
| object | `object` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Object name (file path) |
| credentials_file | `credentials_file` | File | (empty) |   | The run | Service account JSON file. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
